ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (23) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Личность» (lichnost') is 'personality' per the book's terminology, and generic «человек» (chelovek, 'person, man') takes 'he/him' where the website draft had 'themselves/their'. Amiel's italics (*humility*, *reasoning*, *forgiveness*) are restored, and the attributions follow the print, including «Индийский Курал» (Indiyskiy Kural, 'Indian Kural'), which the draft had shortened to 'Kural'.
